name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The classic. Three in a row wins.
summary: Two players take turns marking squares on a 3×3 grid. The first to get three in a row, across, down or diagonally, wins. If the board fills with no line, it's a draw.
help:
Tic-Tac-Toe is for two players.

Take turns tapping an empty square on your own phone. The first player to get three of their symbol in a row, across, down or diagonally, wins.

If the board fills up with no line, it's a draw.
